issue.title: [bug] Chat-only 中转站在 /v1/models 声明了 responses（supported_endpoint_types），Magpie 仍只走 Chat，带工具的请求仍失败（#2670 后续）
issue.body:
#2670 的修复（992f288e，v0.1.1280）我在源码上复核过：只填了 Chat URL 时，同一模型的 tools 请求不会再被进程里的状态卡住；这条 400 也会让分组切到下一个成员。这两点都确认修好了，谢谢。

但对“只填了 Chat URL、却把 `responses` 列进 `/v1/models` 的 OpenAI 兼容中转站”来说，带工具的请求仍然走不通。下面把前因后果和剩下的问题一次说全，希望能一起修掉。

### 环境

- macOS 26.5.1，Apple Silicon。
- 本机运行 Magpie 0.1.1279；源码对照的是 main `d783df4`（v0.1.1285 之后）。下文链接都指向这个提交。
- Codex Desktop 走 Magpie 的 `/v1/responses`，请求带 function tools，effort 为 high/xhigh/max。
- 中转站是自定义 provider，只填了 Chat URL（`.../v1`）。它在两个路由组里都是第一个成员：
  - `auto-gpt-6-1-sol`：另一个成员是 ChatGPT 账号，10/22 前额度用完。这期间组里**只有这个中转站可用**。
  - `auto-gpt-6-astra`：后面还有其他成员。

### 上游的实际行为

10/17–10/18 直接请求这个中转站，每种组合各发一次：

| 模型 | Chat：tools + high | Chat：tools + low | Chat：tools + none | Chat：tools，不带 effort | Chat：max（10/17 Magpie 日志，tools 未单独确认） | Responses：tools + high / xhigh / max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gpt-6.1-sol | 200（不稳定，日志里同组合常返回 400） | 400 tools 拒绝 | 400 `'none' is not supported … 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', and 'max'` | 400 tools 拒绝 | 400 `'reasoning_effort' does not support 'max' with this model. Supported values are: 'low', 'medium', 'high', and 'xhigh'.` | 200 / 200 / 200 |
| gpt-6-astra | 400 tools 拒绝 | 400 tools 拒绝 | 200 | 200 | — | 200 / 200 / 200 |

这个中转站的 `GET /v1/models` 对这两个模型返回：

```json
{"id": "gpt-6.1-sol", "supported_endpoint_types": ["openai", "chat", "responses"]}
{"id": "gpt-6-astra", "supported_endpoint_types": ["openai", "openai-chat", "openai-response"]}
```

也就是说，**Responses 是这个中转站唯一能稳定接受 tools + reasoning 的接口**，而且它在模型列表里已经声明了。Chat 上没有任何 effort 能稳定配合 tools。

### 问题 A（根因）：模型列表声明了 Responses，Magpie 仍只用 Chat

- [`liveModel`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2/internal/catalog/live.go#L675) 只读 `supported_endpoints`（路径形式，如 `/v1/responses`）。这个中转站用的是 `supported_endpoint_types`（类型名，如 `responses` / `openai-response`），所以 `Model.APIs` 为空。
- provider 也只有 Chat URL，所以 `usable()` 只有 Chat，`servesElsewhere` 为 false。
- 结果是：#2670 修好以后，这个中转站的带工具请求从“卡住”变成“每次先失败一次，再交给下一个成员”。但在 `auto-gpt-6-1-sol` 里没有下一个成员，Codex 仍然中断。在 `auto-gpt-6-astra` 里，每个带工具的 turn 都会多一次失败请求，而且实际由别的成员回答。

你在 #2670 里说不在只有 Chat 的 base 上擅自试 Responses，这一点我同意。所以下面的建议都以“上游明确声明”为前提：

1. **识别 `supported_endpoint_types`**（new-api / one-api 系中转站常见），把 `chat`/`openai-chat`、`responses`/`openai-response`、`anthropic` 映射到对应的 API。`openai` 太笼统，可以忽略。
2. 模型声明了 `responses`，而 provider 只填了 Chat URL（形如 `.../v1`）时，可以采用下面任意一种：
   - 默认用同一个 base 发 Responses；
   - 在 UI 里提示“该模型声明了 Responses，补上 Responses URL 即可使用工具”，并支持一键填入。
3. 至少在 provider 编辑页或 `magpie provider test` 中显示“模型列表声明了 Responses，但当前没有 Responses URL”。现在只有请求失败后，错误末尾的 `wrongAPINote` 才会提示。

### 问题 B：Chat 的 `max` 被拒后没有降档，而且不算可重试

日志里 gpt-6.1-sol 在 Chat 上请求 `max` 时，返回 400：

```text
Unsupported value: 'reasoning_effort' does not support 'max' with this model. Supported values are: 'low', 'medium', 'high', and 'xhigh'.
```

这两次的 `tries` 都只有 1 项（`net.asks=2`，第二次实际发出了什么，日志里看不到）。最后这条 400 直接返回给 Codex，没有降到 `xhigh` 成功，组内也没有切到下一个成员。

- 这条报错的格式是 `'reasoning_effort' does not support 'max'`，不是 OpenAI 的 `'max' is not supported`。[`unsupportedEffort`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2/internal/gateway/effort_accounts.go#L95) 匹配不到。走 `effortNamed && effortDenied` 也能识别，但 [`effortRefused`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L2975) 只在 `c.p.Account != nil` 时调用，自定义 API key provider 不会走这条路径。
- [`effortLevelsNamed`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L6362) 的重试只覆盖 `none`/`minimal` 被拒的情况（[L4400](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L4400)），不覆盖“高档位被拒”。
- 同一个模型在 Responses 上接受 `max`，在 Chat 上不接受。所以这个限制取决于 API，不能只按模型记。

希望：对 key provider 也识别“该等级被拒，并列出可用等级”，按 `fitEffort` 降到最近的可用等级重试，并按 provider + model + API 记下来。如果不降档，至少把它当作 `shapeRefused` 让分组切到下一个成员。

### 问题 C：#176 的降级在 Chat 上只是碰运气，组里没有其他成员时仍会中断

修复后，none 被拒时会直接返回 tools 拒绝（[L5158](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L5158)）。这样处理是对的，但对只有一个可用成员的组来说，结果仍然是中断。问题 A 修好后，这一点基本不会再触发。不过，还是希望在 `wrongAPINote` 之外，路由页或这次 try 的记录里也能明确说明“这个 provider 的 Chat 无法接受 tools + reasoning；它的模型列表声明了 Responses，请补 Responses URL”。这样用户能直接看出该怎么修，不必去翻 400 的原文。

### 问题 D（次要）：`composer_predictions` 同样受影响

10/17 的日志里，`kind: composer_predictions` 的请求同样返回了这条 tools 拒绝（tries 只有 1 项）。从 400 的内容看，Codex 的这类请求也带了 tools。这一点我没有单独抓 body 确认。不过问题 A 修好后，它会和主 turn 一样改走 Responses，这里只是提醒测试时把这类请求也覆盖到。

### 期望的最终效果

对这类只填了 Chat URL、但模型列表声明了 `responses` 的中转站，Codex 带 tools 的请求在 high、xhigh、max 下都应直接走 Responses，不再先在 Chat 上失败一次。如果仍然走 Chat 并遇到等级或 tools 拒绝，应在同一 provider 内降档或切换 API；不行时再切到组内下一个成员，并给出可以照着操作的提示。

我可以协助在新版本上复测，issue 也会在复测确认后再关。#2670 可以等这个一起关闭，也可以先关，随你。

issue.title: [feat] agents: pick the API format per agent, and per model where the agent's config has a place for it

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
[feat] agents: let the user pick the API format per agent, and per model where the agent's config has a place for it

## Problem

magpie decides which API each agent asks each model on. Today that decision has no user-facing entry in two different senses, and both end on Chat Completions.

### 1. Where an agent's config has one `api` for the whole provider, it is hard-coded to Chat

| Agent | What magpie writes | Per-model `api`? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pi | `providers.magpie.api: "openai-completions"` (`internal/agent/agents.go`, `magpieProviderJSONAt`) | yes, `models[].api` (`piModelJSON`) |
| omp | `providers.magpie.api: "openai-completions"` (`internal/agent/omp.go`, `ompProviderAt`) | yes, `models[].api` |
| StepCode | `"api": "openai-completions"` (`internal/agent/stepcode.go`, `stepcodeProvider`) | yes, `models[].api` (it passes `native=true` to `piModelJSON`) |
| Droid | `provider: "generic-chat-completion-api"` (`internal/agent/droid.go`) | yes, per model it writes `openai` or `anthropic` |
| DSH | three routes, one per API (`internal/agent/dsh.go`, `dshKinds`) | per route, not per model |
| OpenCode, MiMo Code, DevEco Code | `npm: "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible"` (`agents.go`, `magpieProviderJSONAt`) | no |
| Crush | `type: "openai"` (`agents.go`) | no |
| Pencil | `api: "openai-completions"`, and it passes `native=false` (`internal/agent/pencil.go`) | no |
| Command Code | `api: "openai-completions"` (`internal/agent/commandcode.go`, `ccProviderJSONAt`) | no |
| Hana | `api: "openai-completions"` (`internal/agent/hanako.go`) | no |

For the last five, the config format carries exactly one API for the provider, and magpie writes Chat. A model that its vendor serves on Responses, and answers Chat poorly or not at all with tools (for example a relay's GPT), cannot be asked on Responses from those agents at all — not because magpie translates wrongly, but because there is no place in the file to say Responses, and no setting that would make magpie write something else.

Note this is not the same as a translation choice: even where the gateway would relay a Responses request as it is, the agent never sends one.

### 2. The one setting that does exist is per provider/model, not per agent

`settings.modelAPIs` (`internal/settings/settings.go`, set by `provider.SetModelAPI` in `internal/provider/modelprefs.go`, exposed by the provider editor's model menu as "Protocol: Auto / Responses…") is keyed `"<provider id>/<model id>"`. It has no agent in the key, so:

- setting a model to Responses changes it for **every** agent at once — an agent that handles Responses badly cannot be kept on Chat while another is moved to Responses;
- it is only reachable from the **provider** editor, not from the Agents page, so nothing in the Agents page says which protocol an agent will speak.

Two further gates make it quietly do nothing, both in `internal/provider/modelprefs.go`:

- `setModelAPI` refuses unless the provider has a URL for that API ("has no responses URL to ask … on");
- `Provider.ModelAPI` returns nothing at all when `len(p.Speaks()) < 2`, so on a provider given a single Chat URL a chosen protocol is dropped without a word.

## Why the default is Chat

`Provider.Native` (`internal/provider/provider.go`) returns `ResponsesFirst` or `MessagesFirst`'s answer where it applies, else the first protocol the provider speaks — and `var Protocols = []Protocol{Chat, Responses, Anthropic}` puts Chat first. `ResponsesFirst` only covers `api.openai.com`, PipeLLM, Copilot, Azure and Bedrock GPT. Everything else, including a custom relay whose Responses URL the user typed in, is "Chat-native" here even when it serves GPT (#2704 raises the same point for Pi).

## Proposal

Give the API format a setting at the two levels the agents' own configs can express, without changing what the gateway translates or which API it prefers on its own.

### Agent level

`apiPicks map[string]string` in settings, by agent id — the same shape and the same read as `FastPicks` (`settings.FastPicks`, `provider.FastPicks`, #954): the API every request of this agent's is asked on unless something more specific says otherwise.

Where the agent's config has a provider-level `api`, magpie writes this. Where the config has no such field, the setting is not offered rather than written nowhere.

For an agent that splits magpie into several providers to express several APIs (DSH's `dshKinds` today), this could pick the route each model of magpie's is written on, so the user's choice survives a sync instead of being undone each round.

### Model level, for the agents whose config has it

`apiPicks map[string]map[string]string`, agent id → `"<provider>/<model>"` → API, for the four agents that carry a per-model `api` (Pi, omp, StepCode, Droid). It takes precedence over the agent-level one, and both take precedence over what `Provider.Native` would pick.

`settings.modelAPIs` stays as it is: it is the provider's own answer, and an agent's choice overrides it locally rather than rewriting it for everyone.

### Reusing `Provider.Native`'s answer

The proposal is not to make every model Responses everywhere. `Provider.Native` keeps answering as it does, and the user's setting only overrides it. So a model magpie already asks on Responses, or on Messages, is unchanged; what becomes possible is the case today's default gets wrong.

### Surfacing it

Something in the Agents page, since that is where the user picks a model and where the protocol is otherwise invisible — the model picker's existing per-agent state (#954's bolt, `settings.FastPicks`) is precedent for an agent-scoped control living there. For an agent whose config has no per-model `api`, the control should say so instead of accepting a value magpie cannot write. Where the choice is made is a UI question for the maintainer; the settings semantics above are the part being requested.

## Boundaries

- This asks for a setting, not for a change to `ResponsesFirst`, to the translation targets, or to which API the gateway considers native.
- It does not ask for a new agent, and not for the `modelAPIs` gates above to be removed — those are separate (the silent drop on a single-URL provider is arguably its own bug; listed below for context, not as part of this request).
- I have not built magpie or run it against an agent for this; the statements above are read from `main`'s source at the time of writing. I make no claim about a runtime fault.
- If the intent is instead that `Provider.Native` should stop treating a user-supplied Responses URL as untrusted, that is #2704's proposal, not this one.

## Related

- #997 — the same ask at the agent level, closed with per-model pinning as the answer; per-model pinning turned out to be per provider/model and reachable only from the provider editor.
- #2704 — `catalog.Model.APIs` and the Pi provider default; complementary, about which API is *best*, not about a setting.
- #2758 — "letting the user pick the endpoint per model" for Command Code, whose config has one `api`.
- #1594 — a group of all-Responses members now gets `openai-responses`; the per-model case outside groups is not covered.
- #2094, #2822 — endpoint capability that the picker and the gateway do not honor; adjacent, and separate from having a setting.
- #1954 — `ultraPicks`, the precedent for an agent-scoped setting read beside `FastPicks`.
